cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The sandwiches are floating. Is gravity late for lunch, or has it resigned? We need a serving plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The guests arrive in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Late means plates underneath. Resigned means string on every sandwich. Which are we doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then fetch the deep plates. We may get the whole buffet at once.

mechanism: A directs a catering choice between incompatible gravity explanations and authorizes equipment under the selected one.
confusable: Unlike merely describing floating food, A makes the choice determine plates versus tethering immediately.
comparison: Guest deadline and scarce string differ from scale change and calling outside help.
seedUse: The seed already frames options as action plans and commands plate depth after the selection.
